newsitem.title: CANADA: Serenpet says evaluating purchase offers.
newsitem.headline: Serenpet says evaluating purchase offers.

text.p: Canadian junior oil company Serenpet Inc said on Friday it received a number of offers to purchase the company.

Serenpet, which earlier this year set up a royalty trust from some of its assets in western Canada to erase debt, said it and financial adviser FirstEnergy Capital Corp would take about three weeks to evaluate the offers.
Serenpet shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange closed on Friday up C$0.05 to C$4.35, its year-high, in moderate volume.
Based on Friday's closing stock price, and the company's expectation that its C$19 million of debt will be erased by the royalty trust arrangement, the company would be valued at about C$95 million.
Serenpet vice-president Christina Fehr said she was unable to say how many companies were interested in making a takeover proposal.
"There was a lot of activity in the data room and the offers are reflective of that," she said.
